en: Vintage multi-view postcard with three sepia photographs of a German village. The upper left view, labeled "Total", shows an elevated panorama of the village with clustered gabled houses and surrounding fields. The lower left view, labeled "Dorfstraße", depicts a village street lined with simple residential houses, fences, and trees. On the right, a view labeled "Kirche" shows a church with a tower at the end of a tree-lined path. In the lower right corner, printed caption text identifies the place as Gröden, Kreis Liebenwerda.
